items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: Now, George Washington, the trombone player, well, they all knew that I had never been south.

ctx.x: Now, when we went to Jacksonville -- now this is strange. Now, George Washington, the trombone player, well, they all knew that I had never been south. So we kind of stopped -- we were in Jacksonville, so we kind of stopped --
This was on the way down?
